# XAV Open Model Tutorials

This repository is a Markdown knowledge base for XPU Autonomous Vehicle (XAV) model tutorials.

## Start here

- Human-facing overview: [README.md](README.md)
- LLM wiki map: [wiki/index.md](wiki/index.md)
- Agent maintenance rules: [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)
- Append-only wiki log: [wiki/log.md](wiki/log.md)
- Source tutorials: [tutorials/](tutorials/)

## Repository layers

- `tutorials/*.md` are source tutorial pages. Keep their paths stable; do not move or rename them unless a human explicitly asks.
- `wiki/index.md` is the derived navigation and synthesis layer. Update it when tutorials are added, renamed, or materially changed.
- `wiki/log.md` records wiki maintenance operations, resolved link issues, open questions, and contradictions.
- `CLAUDE.md` defines how future LLMs and maintainers should update the wiki.

## Daily workflows

- Ingest: read a new tutorial/source, summarize it, update relevant wiki pages, update `wiki/index.md`, append to `wiki/log.md`.
- Query: read `wiki/index.md`, inspect relevant source tutorials, answer with cited engineering conclusions.
- Lint: check broken links, orphan pages, unindexed tutorials, contradictions, and missing benchmark evidence.

## Answering rules for LLMs

- Prefer citing the specific tutorial file that supports an answer.
- Do not invent image tags, model paths, dataset paths, version numbers, performance numbers, or support status.
- If README and a tutorial disagree, report the conflict and cite both instead of silently choosing one.
- If a command uses placeholders such as `<XAV_IMAGE>` or `</path/to/model>`, preserve the placeholder and explain that it must be filled from the user's environment.
- For newest or authoritative support status, check [README.md](README.md), [wiki/index.md](wiki/index.md), and [wiki/log.md](wiki/log.md) before answering.
